applied_at_scoring_time_not_by_the_gener.baselines: (i) PTZ-profile ranking, (ii) frequency-of-use ranking from the feasibility census, (iii) class prior with no threads; the matrix must beat the best baseline on classifiable pairs, threshold X fixed before the outcome table is opened
applied_at_scoring_time_not_by_the_gener.not_scorable: a class with fewer than 3 children with a stated outcome is not scorable at scoring time, never neutral
applied_at_scoring_time_not_by_the_gener.uninformative: a class-level test with fewer than 10 classifiable child-agent pairs is declared uninformative in advance

content_reference: ADV declaration of 2026-11-16 (matrix V2: 19 scored classes and rules R1-R3, SCI's class-list proposal accepted); machine encoding by HE. rule.json v1 (sha256 679a60894100d26bf4e550e2f49a888e39b8451dfbf428c2157f8b0cb2d94982) is not modified and still scores v1 cells byte-identically.

directness_rubric.3: the class's primary target is the thread's target

not_adopted: evidence tiers are hand-assigned under this rubric, not derived from the prediction ledger

rules_in_words.R1: a class column is scored only with a link to a thread: a match or aggravation cell at evidence_tier >= 1 and link_directness >= 1 from a held WWOX observation; evaluated per (endpoint, age window), so a class can be scorable in one window and not in another; unknown and neutral cells are not links
rules_in_words.R2: the informativeness denominator and the tie-share limit use the SCORABLE classes of the group only; empty columns never raise informativeness
rules_in_words.R3: a split needs two representatives in each child (distinct agent_id values among the child's cells) and a distinguishing thread (a thread linked, at the R1 minimum, to some children of the split and not to all); a split the cells do not justify makes its children unscorable (printed with the reason), it does not stop the run

status: v2 form; WATCH classes are not matrix columns
thread_set: not a rule: any declared thread id is accepted (amendment 1.1); the generator records the final thread list and its sha256

tier_rubric.1: indirect, or tool pharmacology outside the WWOX system
tier_rubric.2: WWOX-system measurement without a genotype contrast
tier_rubric.3: WWOX-system measurement WITH a genotype contrast
